title: Migrate betterado_user_entitlement, betterado_group_entitlement, and betterado_service_principal_entitlement to terraform-plugin-framework
essence: Three SDKv2 resources (betterado_user_entitlement, betterado_group_entitlement, betterado_service_principal_entitlement) are now served by the mux provider via terraform-plugin-framework. Live acceptance tests ran (TF_ACC=1): TestAccUserEntitlement_Create, TestAccGroupEntitlement_Create, TestAccServicePrincipalEntitlement_create — all passed. Live evidence captured at 2026-07-03T03:18:03Z: ADO REST GET of group entitlement confirmed existence post-apply at dev.azure.com.

checkpoints.label: quality-gate
checkpoints.caption: Offline unit tests for the framework provider and member entitlement packages pass on branch HEAD
checkpoints.beforeNote: Framework resource files did not exist; only SDKv2 paths compiled

checkpoints.label: acceptance-resource
checkpoints.caption: Live group entitlement created via framework resource; ADO REST GET confirms entitlement exists at memberentitlementmanagement endpoint
checkpoints.beforeNote: betterado_group_entitlement was SDKv2-only; no framework path existed
checkpoints.afterNote: Group entitlement 'group-038c153d-c86e-443c-b6f6-3d97378025d0' created via mux→framework provider path; GET response confirms id, displayName, licenseRule, and status=applied match the apply. TestAccGroupEntitlement_Create idempotency re-plan: ExpectNonEmptyPlan: false → PASS
